errors.evidence: The description states that the Y-axis has no units ('без единици'), but the axis is clearly labeled with percentage signs (%), indicating that the unit is percentage.

errors.text_span: леко се повишава до 10–11% през 2010–2012 г.
errors.evidence: The description for Allianz Bank Bulgaria states it rises to 10-11%, but the orange line in the chart remains below the 10% line for the entire period.
The description for TBI Bank states it drops to around 12% in 2013, but the chart shows the value in 2013 is approximately 18%. The drop to ~12% occurs in 2014.
The description for ProCredit Bank claims a peak of around 13% in 2010. The chart shows the peak is slightly above 12% and occurs in 2009, not 2010.

errors.text_span: Тя започва около 23% през 2008 г., спада до около 18% през 2013 г.
errors.evidence: This description of the BACB line is incorrect. The line increases from 2008 to a peak of ~27% in 2011 before it starts to fall. The description misses this initial increase and also incorrectly states the value in 2013 is ~18% when it is actually ~21%.

errors.text_span: достига връх около 14% през 2011 г., след това спада до около 10% през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The description for Tokuda bank contains multiple inaccuracies. The peak of ~14% occurs in 2012, not 2011. The value does not drop to 10% in 2015; in 2015, it is around 12.5%. The drop to ~10% happens around 2017.
The color is described as 'сиво-сива' (grey-grey), which is redundant. 'сива' (grey) is sufficient.
